tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs mchu chen dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i phrin las drag mo'i sku/ /rab gtum bla ma nag po cher btud nas/ /rab myur phrin las ma lus sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rab 'jigs thug chen man ngag bshad kyis nyon/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i rten rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ru mtshon bca' ba'i thabs la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes so/ /dang po ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ru mtshon gnyis las/ 'dir re zhig dang po bshad par bya ste/ thugs kyi rten thug chen la brten nas dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon cing cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi brda dkar las rung ba'i bsnyen pa tshad du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ thug chen gyi sgrub pa byed par 'dod na dang po rgyu/ gnyis pa dus/ gsum pa byin rlabs/ bzhi pa mgar ba byin rlabs nas brdung ba'i bar gri gug gi sgrub thabs las gsungs pa ltar byed cing / thug chen gyi rtsa ba ni/ yongs su sgrub pa po'i rtse khru gang pa/ rtse mo dpal gyi sar zur gsum pa shin tu rno ba me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ zhal bzhi pa dang / lha mo'i rten gyi mdung dpangs su rkang gang pa/ zur rno ba dbal rnams thug chen dang 'dra ba la thug chen gyi mdung so nas mdung lcags kyi rtsa ba'i bar la gri khrag dang rang byung gi mtshal la mtshal dang bcas pa'am/ gser gyis chos skyong lcam dral dang / zhal bzhi pa lcam dral gyi gzungs ring thung rnams bri/ zhal bzhi pa'i rten mdung dang lha mo'i rten mdung gnyis la rang rang gi gzungs bri/ de nas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i shing bzo ba mgar ba ltar byin gyis rlabs te/ rgyu'i khyad par rab chu shing / seng ldeng stag pa la sogs pa/

ma 'byor na shol po/ lcang ma/ shug pa la sogs pa'i mdung shing 'dom gang las mi thung ba mtshal lam btsag la sogs pa dug khrag dang sbyar bas kha dog dmar por bsgyur bar bya/ gsom dben shing yin pas mi rung / glang ma 'byung po'i bla shing yin pas mi rung / thug chen gyi mdung lcags kyi nang du 'gro tshad la/ snag tsha sngar ltar gyis bla ma'i mtshan 'bum dang / de nas yi dam gyi sngags/ de nas chos skyong che chung / lcam dral rang rang gi gzungs dang / rgyas par na de'i rjes su bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi bcol bskul brgyud pa'i mtshan byang dang so so'i sngags kyi gsham du sbyar/ bsdu na brgyud pa'i mtshan byang la yi dam chos skyong gi sngags rnams mthud pa'i rjes su/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams thugs kyi rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad sol/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub/ ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar du bsrung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sbed pa dang / gar rbad du 'gro bar gyis shig ces pa dang / ye dharmā/ bskul tshig dang bcas pa bri/ thug rnga rab 'brong rnga/ g.yag 'bras bu can gyi rnga ma/ ma 'byor na rnga ma nag po gang yang rung ba rnams/ sems can de nad ngan gyis ma shi ba dang de'i rnga ma'ang 'og la ma shor ba shing gi 'khor lo'i rgya gram la brten nas mdzes par btags/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gsung gi rten du lcam dral zhal sogs kyi srog 'khor sngags can dang gong gi bcol bskul/ sku'i rten ro ras sam shog bu la mgon po'i sku sor bzhi pa gri khrag gis bris pa la rab gnas tshul bzhin byas/ phyag g.yas nas rim bzhin 'phred la dril/ dar skud sna lngas dkris/ dar snas bcings la gri lcags sam/

snyug rgod kyi sbubs su bcug la phyi nas la chus byugs/ srog 'khor kyang de ltar bcings la la ris bya/ drag po'i shing tsher ma can la byang bu mtho gang pa bcos pa'i ngos la mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sngags kyi mjug tu spel tshig dang bcas pa/ dug khrag dang snag tshas bris pa la la chus byugs/ thugs kyi rten du me long gi ngos su gri khrag dang sin+dhu ras hūm̐ yig bris pa/ yon tan gyi rten du ras sam dar gyi khug ma'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs/ sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba/ phrin las kyi rten du/ gong gi shing byang / khrab byang mig dgu pa/ bse byas/ stag ras/ gzig ras/ mgron bu'i lan tshar/ dril bu g.yer kha/ mi mgo mi lag mi snying la sogs pa/ dar ras sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / 'phan tshar ci mang / de dag thams cad gong gi rnga ma'i zhom chen gyi khrod du gdags/ gzhan yang de la dar nag sogs kyi cod paṇa dang / 'phan gdugs/ dar nag sogs la sku dang / gri gug sogs phyag mtshan dang / gzungs bris pa'i 'phyar dar btags/ de lta bu'i thug chen de la 'grub na kyai rdo rje sogs la brten pa'i rab gnas rgyas 'bring gnyis gang rung dang / bsdus na/ sbyangs khrus/ rten bskyed ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod bstod/ spyan dbye/ brtan bzhugs/ zhal sgyur shis brjod de rab gnas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang byed kyang rten bskyed kyi skabs su/ thug mgon po 'khor bcas sogs su bskyed/ zhal bsgyur gyi tshe zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon gyi rnam par bsgyur ro/ /de nas mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar la thug sgrub bya ste de yang mgon khang la sogs pa'i gnas su rten gyi drung du chos 'byung mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa thug mang nyung gi grangs dang bstun bris pa'i dbus su thug chen dang / g.yas su zhal/ g.yon du lha mo/ mgon po'i mdun nam lha mo'i g.yon du las mkhan gyi ru mtshon rnams mi 'gyel bar bzhag pa'i drung mchod gtor rgyun gyi gtor bsngo bskang ba bzhin la gang rgyas bshams bar rang nyid kha phyogs pa'i stan dang rdo rje dril bu sogs rgyun bshams/

zla gcig gam zhag bdun nam gsum sogs kyi bar la mtshams bcad de thun bzhi gsum gang rung gi sgrub tshul ni kyai rdo rje sogs yi dam lha'i bdag bskyed dam/ mgon po brag rdzong ma gang rung sngon du btang nas mdun gyi thug a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lcam dral sogs su gtor bsngo sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren bstim/ dbang bskur/ mgon po la mi bskyod pa dang gzhan rnams la mgon pos rgyas btab/ rang rang gi rigs bdag dmigs bsal yod pa rnams la de bzhin bya/ dam bzhag gtor bsngo/ mchod pa 'phrin bcol/ bstod pa rnams ci shes byas la/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ de'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas chos 'khor du 'khor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po lcam dral gyi thugs khar phog pas bdag bskyed mdun bskyed kyi sngags rnams dang phyag mtshan gri gug la sogs pa las kyang 'od zer me stag tsha tsha 'phro ba lta bu'am/ glog gam/ skar mda' lta bu 'phros pa las dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad khro bo'i sku dpag tu med par byon nas/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi sku thams cad la thim pas/ gzi brjid dang drag shul dang ldan par byas/ gsung gi yi ge 'bar zhing 'brug gi sgra ltar byon nas mgrin par thim pas ngag nus pa dang ldan par byas/ thugs phyag mtshan gri gug dang / gaṇ+ḍe dang / thod pa dang / ral gri dang / mdung chen dang / rtse gsum 'bar ba'i rnam par byon nas thugs kar thim pas/ thugs 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa/

ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan du gyur bar bsams zhing / dang por lhag pa'i lha'i sngags dang / de nas phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sngags dang / mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bzlas pa brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa ci 'grub bzla/ thun mtshams rnams su yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs byas la thun gtor phul ba'i rjes su ye dharmā mang du bzlas pa'i mthar brtan bzhugs dang mjug chog rgyun gyi gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs spyi 'gre byas nas bsgrubs pa dang / grub pa'i rtags dngos sam/ rmi lam du sgra dang / 'od dang thug las me 'bar ba dang / mi nag dang bud med nag mo zhugs pa dang / bskor ba byed cing sha za ba la sogs pa byung na grub pa'i rtags yin pas las la sbyor bas chog pas/ mgon khang gi steng la sogs par ru mtshon de nyid 'jug chog dngos ni/ de lta bu'i thug chen de khang thog der brtan par 'dzugs pa'am phyogs bzhir thag rgyangs byas la bzhugs/ de'i mtha' bskor du bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pa legs par bkram la/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi sku bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs pa'i drung rin po che/ gos dar/ dkar dpyad/ lpags rigs/ go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs 'byor tshad dang / rten rdzas rta g.yag sogs dngos sam bris 'bur gang rung / yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma'ang che zhing sha mar gyi rgyan bzang la ba dan dang dar gyi 'phyangs 'phrul la sogs pas mdzes par spras/ zhi drag gi mchod pa rnams kyang rgya cher bsham shing / khyad par gsol kha gang la byed pa'i gtor ma ni rab khal gsum/ 'bri khal gcig tha ma bre lnga las mi nyung ba las byas pa'i gtor ma la/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po lnga'i me tog rgyu ma'i lda ldi/ snying tshang mar btsugs pa la khrag dang zhag gi bdud rtsi mang po bsdus pa blug dkar phud/ dmar phud/ shig tog sna tshogs/

sha sna khrag sna/ zas sna'i rigs tshang ba la rin po che brdar/ sman dri bzang sna tshogs kyang blug spos sna tshogs btab/ 'khur ba/ la phug nya sha sgog btsong rnams kyang bran/ dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas kyang bcos/ dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bshams/ stag sder bzhi ma nyams pa'am/ gzhi ma dkar po ma nyams pa'i steng du nas gtsang ma'i gdan la mañji'i khar bzhag khrus dang sbyong chas/ rdor dril rnga rol sogs rol mo'i bye brag 'byor tshad dang / tshogs kyi yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ nged rang las bsgrigs pa'i mgon po'i bzlog pa po sogs nas 'byung ba'i bsgral mchod kyi chas tshang ma/ skye bo go mtshon can nam gzabs chas gang 'phor gyon pas 'phyor gyon la 'phyar dar gyi rigs sna tshogs bzung ba bcas 'dus byas la/ gza' skar drag cing bzang ba'i tho rangs sam gangs nyi rtse tsam nas bzung ste cho ga 'dzugs par bya ste/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma gtor bzlog nas 'byung ba bzhin/ gnas yo byin brlabs/ mchog tu shes pa kyai rdo rje'i bdag mdun las bum sgrub pa/ yi dam chos srung gi gtor bsngo bskang ba nas bzung bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ ru mtshon la zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i myong ba rnams spyi 'gre bzhin la/ 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa la rdo rje brgyan/ rten khrus dang ru mtshon la phar phyin drug gi khrus/ gang la ser sna'i shis brjod bzang khrus bcas byas la/ gsol kha'i gtor ma dang mchod pa la dmigs/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i ri bo/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing /

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgyar bcas la ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thug rnams lcam dral sogs rang rang gi bskyed chog dang de rnams kyi mdun du dur khrod kyi sa gzhir/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su/ bdud rta bra nag rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng du/ ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bdud kyi khram shing rtse mo gsum pa'i mgul na/ dar nag gi ba dan dang / mi mgo'i lan tshar 'phyang ba sku la brten pa/ g.yon pas mi snying rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa dug sbrul nag po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa zhal du 'jib cing phyir sprug pa/ lcags kyi ral pa nag po drag tu sprug cing gsig pa/ lcags kyi mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs nas ya sos ma mchu mnan pa sku stod la dar nag gi ber zhol gsol zhing / sku smad gcer bu la dug sbrul mang po lang long du dkris pa/ skad cig nyid la stong gsum yud kyis bskor zhing / dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs sdud pa'i drag shul can/ de'i g.yon phyogs su ma bdud spu gri'i mched mo srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can/ gcer mo rgyan med rkang pa gsum bgrad stabs kyis gnas pa/ phyag gnyis kyis me dpung 'bar ba 'dzin cing / kha nas me 'bar ba gdong phyir phyogs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang me rlung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de nas gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug dam la bzhag pa/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams dkyus bzhin la/ bran bdud kyi gtor sngags/ ma hā kā la yak+ṣa mur tsa kro dha ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ bh+yo ma ri ma sha mud tsa ya bh+yo sarba bighān sha trūn mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma 'bul/

de nas/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ nag po chen po lcam dral gyis gtso mdzad pa'i/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ phyogs bcu'i gnas rnams nas byon mdun gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par bzhugs par bsam la/ dar nag 'phyar/ rol mo rnams kyi sgra sgrogs/ gu gul dang / sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ dam tshig gi rdo rje dar nag gi g.yab dar bcas pa/ mi rkang dang shugs pa'i sgras 'bod/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pas/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pa dang / /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lha chen mā hā kā la dang / /e ka dza ti re ma ti/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra gnyis/ /sring mor bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /sgo ma bzhi dang ru 'dren bzhi/ /pho nya dgu dang gaṇ+ḍe'i dmag /dur khrod bdag po phyogs skyong bcu/ /sde brgyad dregs pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug dang / /yum chen bzhi dang pho nya'i tshogs/ /che btsan drag po mthu bo che/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /sprin ltar 'thib pas 'dir gshegs shig /glog ltar 'khyug pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar grags pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'dril bas 'dir gshegs shig /hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /hūm̐ dam can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /byin brlabs yon tan 'thung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang /

/dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūm̐ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thog myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sbyin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /ces yid ma yengs par spyan drangs la/ bsnyen sngags rnams kyi mjug tu/ e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing drag rol yun ring du bya/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi mgo bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /nag po lcam dral rnams la 'bul/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi sa pā ri wā ra a3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 2,238 undefined in unicode!> pra tits+tsha swāhāḥ zhes pa la sogs pa gzhan rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste 'bul/ gnyis pa nang bdud rtsis mchod pa ni/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te mtheb srin gyis gtor zhing / thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa spros pas mchod par bsam la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ yum chen e ka dza ṭī'i zhal duྎ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyugྎ nag po gnod sbyin yab yum zhal duྎ dam can pu tra ming sringྎ las mdzad sgo ma bzhi'iྎ stobs chen ru 'dren bzhi'iྎ 'bar ba'i pho nya dguྎ sprul pa'i dmag tshogs dpag medྎ 'khor gyi lha srin sde brgyad zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /rgyas par byed na tshig lhug pas lha grangs bzhin re rer dbul/ mthar snying po dang rtsa sngags kyi gzhug tu/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/

'bru bcu stong sbyar dza gad dang / /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /byin gyis brlabs nas dbul bar bgyi/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa gsang ba dam rdzas gyi mchod pa ni/ khyed kyi thugs dam bdag bskul gyi/ /brten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bsgrub pa'i tshe na gong ma g.yel/ /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul/ /jo bor byas na dbang ma che/ /grogs por byas na gzhung ma ngan/ /bran ltar brten na ru ma nga / /sring mor brten na tshul ma 'da'/ /do nub khyed kyi thugs dam bskangs/ /do nub sngar gyi gtang rag gtong / /do nub phyis kyi zhu don gsol/ /bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /'bod pa'i dam tshig btsan pa'i phyir/ /g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskangs/ /shin tu gus pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /spyan 'dren tshig gis thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs kyi gsang ba yin pa'i phyir/ /bya rgod mda' yis thugs dam bskangs/ /pho nya las mkhan sdud pa'i phyir/ /ru mtshon nag pos thugs dam bskangs/ /gzhal yas khang du bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /dar nag gur gyis thugs dam bskangs/ /brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /tsit+ta snying gi thugs dam bskangs/ /bya khyi lug nag rgyal mtshan gyis/ /ma hā kā la'iྎ /dam tshig gnyen po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyiྎ /rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir/ /khrag gi at+p+raṃྎ /ljags kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i/ /maṃ sa rtsi bcudྎ /dri chen dri la snom pa'i phyir/ /sha chen dud pas thugs damྎ /rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen posྎ /'phral du phrin las 'chol ba'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi gtor masྎ /rol mo'i sgra la dgyes pa'i phyir/ /thod rnga gling busྎ /mchog dang thun mong stsal ba'i phyir/ /mi brjed gzungs kyisྎ /dpal ldan nag po'iྎ /yab kyi thugs dam bskangs ba'i phyir/

/pe ta nag mo'iྎ /dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren pa'i phyir/ /legs ldan nag po'iྎ /bdud kha gzhan du bsgyur ba'i phyir/ /rgya gar nag po'iྎ /dmag dpung ru mtshon bzlog pa'i phyir/ /sprul pa 'bum gyiྎ /dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong bskangs/ /mgon po'i sring bzhi yin pa dang / /nad kha dgra la sgyur ba'i phyir/ /re ma ti yiྎ /bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang / /hūm̐ dpal ldan chos skyong mgon po khyod/ /mtha' yas chos kyi sku brnyes kyang / /thugs rje smon lam rgya chen gyis/ /kun rdzob tshul du 'gro don mdzad/ /sgrub mchog bsam pa rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas bsags gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir/ /lha chen mgon po khyed la 'bul/ /sngon gyi zhal bzhes bskul ba'i phyir/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phrin las rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /dang sems 'bad stsol chen po yis/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog dam pa 'di/ /byams pa'i sems kyis bzhes su gsol/ /dus gsum bde gshegs 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje nag po la/ /dges pa'i dam rdzas mchog 'di 'bul/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /rnam dag tshogs kyi gtor ma 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas spel/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdud rtsi'i tshul du bzhes su gsol/ /thugs dam bskangs la phrin las mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chag kun/ /skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /mdzes pa'i spu sdug mkha' la lding / /bya nag lcags kyi mchu sder can/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'gre/ rta mchog nag po sprin gyi shugs/ /myur mgyogs mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ /mgon poྎ /g.yag rgod lcags rmig khro chu'i mig /mdzes pa'i ra dang rnga yab can/ /mgon poྎ /khyi nag dung gi mche ba can/ /seng ge'i stobs ldan rngam zhing rgyug

/mgon poྎ /lug nag lcags ru dar gyis brgyan/ /bdud kyi spu nor mdzes pa 'di/ /mgon poྎ /mi nag gying po srog gi gshed/ /las la khol ba'i stobs ldan 'di/ /mgon poྎ /dpal gyi zhal zas 'brang rgyas mchog /rak+ta'i thig les brgyan pa 'di/ /mgon poྎ /rak+ta'i yon chab rab 'khyil ba/ /srog rtsa'i lam nas bton pa 'di/ /mgon poྎ /gri snying rtsa lag ma nyams pa/ /rin chen lnga dang sman gyis bkang / mgonྎ /'bru bcud stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /gzi brjid che 'bar mnga' bskyed chang / /mgon poྎ /mnyen drang sba snyug rtse rgyal la/ /spu sdug bya yi gsob dang bcas/ /mgon poྎ /nam mkha' sku rten rgyangs bu la/ /'phan gdugs mdzes pa'i skor dang bcas/ /mgon poྎ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshang ma 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /khrag 'thung chen po'i thugs damྎ /che btsan drag po'i thugs damྎ /bdud 'dul dbang phyugྎ /rig 'dzin srog shingྎ /gsang sngags srung ma'iྎ /dpal ldan lha mo'iྎ /ma gcig lha mo'iྎ /'dod khams gtso mo'i thugsྎ /bdud kyi yum chenྎ /gshin rje'i lcam gcigྎ /srid pa'i rgyal mo'iྎ /gsang sngags srung ma'iྎ /dur khrod bdag mo'iྎ /lha srin sde brgyadྎ /dregs pa'i 'khor gyiྎ /las mkhan nag po'iྎ /bka' sdod pho nya'i thugs dam bskangs/ /khyed kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur nas/ /bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du brlog /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las/ /thugs rje chen po'i sku sprul pa/ /skye med ngang las 'jigs byed sku/ /bstan srung dam las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /bdud lug nag po spyi dkar dang / /mkha' lding nag po gser mig dang / /bdud rtsi rnam lnga sbyar ba yi/ /dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho dang /

/dpa' bo chang gi ro mchog dang / /sman rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu dang / /rin chen lnga yi phye ma dang / /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / drag po'i bshos bu zur gsum dang / sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /dar tshon lnga yimachod pa dang / /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dbyangs 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas mchod/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje brag gi steng / /chags pa'i skyon spangs pad+ma'i gdan/ /'khor ba'i 'dam skem nyi ma'i dbus/ /bdag med snying po ro stengs su/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍe phyag dbus bsnams/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /gzugs thung kha nas khrag 'dzag cing / /gzi brjid che la 'jigs su rung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad mgon/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang / /gri gug 'dzin pa'i thugs damྎ /thod phreng can gyiྎ /tshogs kyi bdag po'iྎ /rnal 'byor bka' nyanྎ /sras mchog nag po'iྎ /las kyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /sprul pa'i dmag tshogsྎ /sha la sred pa'iྎ /khrag la rngam pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig /gson dang ma hā kā la'i tshogs/ /bstan pas khyab pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la mi bden med/ /zab mo'i don la mi sems med/ /mna' dang khrims la mi gnas med/ /zas skom nor la mi chags med/ /dges pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /nyams chag ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /sngar byas las kyi gtang rag gtong / /da bcol las kyi zhu skyems 'dren/ /dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyen po bskang bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/

/chos skyong srung ma'i thugs dam bskang / /rgyal ba'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs damྎ /lha min dmag dpung bzlog pa'i phyir/ /lha chen dpal 'barྎ /dam tshig gnyen po bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha'iྎ /bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rigs 'dzin srung ma'iྎ /myur du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i phyir/ /pho nya las mkhanྎ /thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa dang / /dza gad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang / /la du la phug dzam+bu ti/ /sha chen dmar gyi mchod chen dang / /dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi/ /glo snying nang khrol dbang po lnga/ /rus pa rkang klad tshil bu dang / /bya rgod mda' dang dar nag 'phan/ /gri rgod snying dang dar sna tshogs/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'dis/ /mchod do mgon po 'khor bcas mchod/ /bskang ngo thugs dam gnyen po bskangs/ /'bul lo mchod pa'i dam rdzas 'bul/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bzhengs/ /mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ༈ /gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum/ /e ka dza ṭi+ā'i thugs dam bskangs/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i thugsྎ /de yi bka' nyan las byed ma/ /g.yog gnyis 'jigs ma'iྎ /nad rim kun gyi bdag mo ste/ /ma mo 'bum sde'iྎ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /bskang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa ni/ /gtor chen sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan/ /mi dbang 'bras bu smin pa'i sha /shing lo sa la ma lhung dang / /bya mo nag mo la sogs pa'i/ /'dod pa'i dam rdzas dpag med 'dis/ /mchod do 'dod khams bdag mo mchod/ /bskang ngo lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /'bul lo mchod do dam rdzas 'bul/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul/ /mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ༈ /gzhan yang 'khor du gtogs pa ni/ /ba lang ma dang khri brnyan ma/ /chu srin gdong can la sogs pa/

/mi sdug srin mo'i cha byad can/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /rngam zhing gsod pa'i las la brtson/ /nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskangs/ /dgra bgegs gnas nas 'gugs pa'i phyir/ /pho nya rnams kyiྎ /dgra bgegs zil gyis mnan pa'i phyir/ /khyung chen tshogs kyi thugsྎ /dgra bgegs sha la rol ba'i phyir/ /bya nag tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs/ /dgra khrag skom du btung ba'i phyir/ /khyi nag tshogs kyi thugsྎ/dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod pa'i phyir/ /mi nag tshogsྎ /dgra bo'i bla la 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /ce spyang sngon mo'iྎ /khyed kyi mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /bza' ba sha yi ri bo la/ /btung ba khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil/ /dri gsur ngad pa sprin du 'khrigs/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa 'dis/ /pho nya las mkhan thugs dam bskang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi/ /ji ltar bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas/ /ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho bdun bcas/ /rin chen bdun dang rin chen gter/ /skye 'gro'i sems can sna tshogs bkod/ /khyung chen glang chen ma he rta/ /gser g.yu byu ru mu tig shel/ /dar zab gos dang 'bru yi tshogs/ /mi zad longs spyod gter dang ldan/ /bzhes shig thugs dam gnyen po bskangs/ /bstan pa gnyen po bsrung bar mdzod/ /sgrub po'i bar chad sel ba dang / /rkyen ngan rbod gtong bzlog par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ bzhi pa bde ba chen po'i mchod pa ni/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyi bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes par bsgom pa'o/ /lnga ba bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ thog mar bka' bstod kyi dmigs pa bya ste/ ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag dang / dar thag btags pa'i sne nas rnal 'byor pa gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pas bzung / dpon slob rnams mgrin gcig tu/

mgon po 'khor bcas kyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam re 'ur 'don bya/ de'i tshe rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa lta bar mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar phri li li yod par bsam/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gam gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzungs thag sogs nas bzung / 'og gi bskul mi byed par shā sa na'i sngags rgyun ma chad par bzung / gzhan rnams kyis 'brub khung bskyed chog nas bzung / ma hā ko ra tsa na khā hi bar bzlog mdos kyi bsgral mchod sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / ling ros gtor ma rnams cung zad gsos/ byings gsol kha'i phyir bzhag chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi gtor sngags rnams bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod pas/ gang la bya ba'i sha khrag nag po chen po'i zhal du sib sib song zhing til tsam yang ma lus par gsol bar bsam mo/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga mchod byas la/ gsol kha bya ba ni/ sngar gyi stegs bu'i kha'i gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu dang / chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phye mar dang khrag chab bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du ling ro'i dum bu dang / g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon du phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra ba lan gsum gtor chen la btab cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang kyang thigs re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho/

rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam/ de rnams mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam sa tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis bstabs pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes nas/ bdag gis ci bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsam la/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag rngam pa'i sku/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon na thod khrag 'dzin/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam dbu la bcings/ /mi mgo'i do shal rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dpa' bo stag shams zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bstod nag po che la bstod/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid thugs su chud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes tshogs rdzogs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rnams yongs kyi ded dpon dpa' bo che/ /legs ldan nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma mo kun gyi gtso mo dbang phyug che/ /dur khrod bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' dang bstan pa bsrung mdzad dam tshig che/ /ma hā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu bo che/ /ma hā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod do/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal ldan/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i zhal du 'bul/ /dges pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po nyer dgongs te/

/rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po nag po sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po/ rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ ma hā de wa'i sras mchog lha chen dpal 'bar/ 'jigs byed chen po/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi bdud po khyed rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hī khā hi/ zhes brjod cing mgon po'i gtor sngags/ shā sa na lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po bstabs/ yang sngar bzhin bshams la/ gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo/ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dur khrod kyi bdag mo/ gshin rje'i lcam mo/ bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo/ bdud kyi yum chen/ nad do cog gi bdag mo/ 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / dur khrod kyi bdag po/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ bka' nyan gnod sbyin yab yum/ las mkhan mon pa ming sring / mdun gyi shul 'dren/ g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes nyul/ mkha' lding / bya nag khyi nag lcags spyang sngon po/ mi nag po 'o dod can/ sprul pa khro bo'i tshogs/ bdud nag po gshin rje'i tshogs/ gdong can gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam pa 'bul zhing gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /rol chen dang / lha mo las mgon rnams kyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum bzla zhing /

gsol kha gnyis pas bstabs/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te khyed rnams kyis dgyes shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa/ gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang / mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud cig ral na tshems shig stor na tshol la/ brjed na skul cig mgo gang gi yar la stod la/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya dang sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrubs la re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thams cad shigs cig dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chod la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang brling mdzod cig bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig

ces 'khor bcas dril ba'i sngags rnams rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstabs/ gdong bzhi pa'i ru mtshon yod na gsol kha rgyas pa ni de nyid kyi gtor chen gyi gsol kha las byung ba ltar bya/ mdor bsdu na 'di'i gsol kha gnyis pa lha mo dang las mkhan gyi mjug tu/ hoḥ dpal ldan nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rigs 'dzin rnams kyi srog shing / rnal 'byor rnams kyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul sngags kyi dbang phyug srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu'i grong khyer laṅka pu ri gtan nas rlog par byed pa/ lha ma yin gyi bu mo nam mkha'i glog phreng can rdul du rlog pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ yum las kyi gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi/ g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang khu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo/ rgyab tu siṅga gling ser mo/ 'khor gnod sbyin dang / srin po sha za zhing skyong dang bcas pa/ srog gi sgo bdud nag po/ las kyi bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig skye 'gro'i bdud gcod/ dam nyams kyi srog len/ chos 'khor gyi srung ma/ 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi mchod pa dam par 'bul lo/ /zhes dang / de rjes rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang zhes sogs brjod cing / de ltar na gsol kha'i rdzas rnams kyang tshar re la tshan pa bzhi bzhi bstabs par bya'o/ /yang sngar bzhin la bstod pa nas bzung / bstabs pa'i bar lan gnyis te bdun dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang de dag gi lhag ma lus pa rnams kyang bstabs/ lcam dral zhal bzhi pa sogs kyi mnga' gsol rnams rgyas par btang nas/ gzungs thag rnams bkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du sgrub cing /

khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs par bsams la/ ru mtshon gang yod kyi chos skyong rnams kyi drag bskul ci shes 'don/ bar la lha gsol dang drag bskul gcig 'thus byed par spro na/ bdag chen grags blo bas mdzad pa'i mgon po mnga' gsol gyi/ hūm̐ dpal chen nas/ dbang zhing rngam par mnga' gsol bar brjod la gzungs thag bkrol/ drag po'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ hūm̐ dam can rgya mtsho sogs nas/ phun sum tshogs par shog bar brjod/ bran bdud la bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ ri rab ri yi rtsa ba nas/ /las mgon chen po sku bskyod cig /nam gyi gung dang nyin gung la/ /dam nyams dgra bo gsod cing byon/ /'khor ni bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / /gza' bdud bdun brgya pho nyar bcas/ /dam la 'das pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mthun pa'i yo byad ji snyed rnams/ /tshogs bcas 'bul lo bstan pa'i las/ /bdag cag bsrung phyir 'dir bsten no/ /nag po dran phyir 'dir bsten no/ /bka' las ma 'da' 'dir bzhugs shig /dgos 'dod bsgrub phyir 'dir bzhugs shig /ji srid ma gshegs bar dag tu/ /gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /gang bcol las rnams bsgrub tu gsol/ /ces brjod/ de nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas sogs la rten du 'bul ba'i tshig 'di ltar brjod/ hūm̐ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs bcas dgongs/ /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po che/

/e ka dza ti 'dod khams ma/ /phyi nang las mkhan zangs gri can/ /gnod sbyin nag po yab yum dang / /dam can pu tra ming sring gsum/ /pho nya ru 'dren gaṇ+ḍe'i dmag /bran bdud nag po lcam dral dang / /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud bcas/ /zhing skyong drag po gdong bzhi pa/ /las mdzad yum chen sring mo bzhi/ /sde brgyad bshan pa bcas pa kun/ /bdag la brtse dgongs rten la zhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i rba klong ljongs/ /dam nyams baṃ chen bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /brtan par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phan rtse gsum/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsakli/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag 'gron bu'i lan tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil 'khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen po 'dzugs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ /'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpung ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /sdang byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog

/rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/ /mi nor chos dang legs tshogs kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs byed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid kyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ bstan pa dang rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ bdag bskyed dang rjes 'brel tshogs 'khor/ spyi bstabs/ mjug chog rnams bya'o/ /de ltar srung ma rnams la ru mtshon btsugs pa'i phan yon ni/ ru mtshon gyi rten de nyid gang du yod par/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mkha' la sprin 'du ba'am/ mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba'am/ sha rul la sbrang bu 'du ba ltar/ gnas de nyid du rtag par bzhugs nas/ yul phyogs dge mtshan dang ldan pa dang / sgrub po rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad sgrub par 'gyur bas/

tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs 'di ni/ phur chen sgrub pa'i yi ge dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ mnga' gsol gtor chen ru mtshon gyi cho ga rnams lhan cig tu thon pa bdag chen grags blo bas mdzad pa/ gtor chen dang gsol kha'i yi ge rgya pad+ma dbang phyug gi gtor ma dang / yon tan phrin las kyis mdzad pa/ thug chen bcol bskul bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gur mdos bla chen bsod blos mdzad pa/ ru mtshon 'dzugs chog tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa rnams dgung bsgrigs te sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba 'di la yig cha de rnams kyi dgongs pa dang mthun min mkhas grub rnams kyis gzigs par zhu// //shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
